decisions.name: Two PDF Portfolio wrappers
decisions.reason: The Paragon-repeat portfolio and the EGLE available-cyanide portfolio each embed an exact byte-for-byte copy of a separately supplied, browser-readable report. The two wrappers are suppressed and the complete extracted reports are retained.

decisions.name: Eight records already published
decisions.reason: Seven byte-identical records and one visually identical KAR biosolids analytical report reuse their stable archive sources. The KAR record title and year were corrected to match the report's September 2018 content.

decisions.name: Trace AMR originals and revisions
decisions.reason: The 2024 and 2025 original and revised Trace packages have different page counts and rendered content. Each version remains independently searchable.

decisions.name: Paragon and ERM WET reports
decisions.reason: Similar laboratory templates cover different test dates, projects, organisms and reported results. They are distinct monitoring events, not duplicate copies.

decisions.name: Compliance monitoring field sheets
decisions.reason: Three visually related forms carry different dates, contacts, sampling parameters and location instructions. Each remains a separate record.

decisions.name: Former duplicate-labeled WET report
decisions.reason: The February 2017 ERM WET report is distinct from all other WET packages. It is retained without the supplied 'Duplicates_' label.

decisions.name: Scan-based laboratory packages
decisions.reason: OCR was used for image-only or extraction-resistant pages, including encrypted WET reports, Trace revisions, toxicity studies and photographed field records.
